title: Sharing my view on EA's. Struggling to stay consistent with manual trading? Here's what a fully automated approach looks like...
author: stan4848
selftext:
If you've ever blown an account because of revenge trading, overleveraging after a loss, or just not sticking to your own rules — you're not alone. That's exactly why I moved to a fully automated system.

**Currency algo:** 38% over 20 trading days

Runs 24/5 on MT5, no manual intervention, no emotions, no deviating from the plan. Fixed position sizing per trade, no martingale. Ive been very happy with the results.

Happy to answer questions about the bot in my DM.

**Example trade: CADCHF swing capture**

Entry at local support, exit near resistance — no guesswork, no emotions, just the algo following its rules.

Two trades captured within the same uptrend: buy the dip, sell into strength, repeat.
